questions.stem: Where does blood go immediately after leaving the right ventricle?

options.text: To the lungs via the pulmonary artery
To the vena cava and then the kidneys
To the left atrium via the pulmonary vein
To the aorta and then the body

questions.explanation: The right ventricle pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs through the pulmonary artery, where gas exchange occurs and the blood becomes oxygenated.
